correctness.rationale: Direct polynomial-core creation/annihilation expansion yields all diagonal and two-step blocks, including the vacuum term. Long high-frequency packets test the full matrix angular symbol; its positive semidefinite trace-zero nature forces the constant and oscillatory coefficients to vanish. Then positivity is exactly A*A-BB*≥0; a closed-adjoint graph limit transfers core positivity to the closure. Finite truncation checker passed 3789 checks, and the nonnormal example was computed symbolically; these are supplementary, not universal proofs.

value.rationale: The arbitrary finite-multiplicity matrix generalization of a current scalar Fock–Sobolev hyponormality question is natural. It gives an exact three-identity classification, shows finite-dimensional trace annihilates all high-energy oscillatory terms, computes the vacuum anomaly and essential spectrum, and supplies explicitly interacting nonnormal matrices satisfying it. These extend the mathematical structure, not just the scalar parameter.
